scoring_justification: Only final tricritical coordinates are submitted; no intermediate a/b or q0z grid is available for full recompute, so we compare reported values to paper-derived gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.generation_method: exact Dt from paper; Tt estimated from figures, checked against typical effective-field results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Dt values are explicitly reported in the paper. Tt values are read from published phase diagram curves, verified to be physically plausible and consistent with the model.

Omega_over_J.description: transverse field divided by exchange coupling

Tt_over_J.description: tricritical temperature in units of J/k_B

neg_Dt_over_J.description: absolute value of tricritical longitudinal crystal field divided by J

outputs.description: Computed tricritical points; compared to hidden reference values from the paper with a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the effective-field theory from the given formulas; no external datasets are needed. The hidden checker compares the reported Tt_over_J and neg_Dt_over_J to gold values with relative tolerance.
